description: When classes share responsibilities and collaborators, lift them into a base class. Use ': BaseClass' notation. Reference base type in relationships instead of enumerating subtypes.

do.description: Abstract shared responsibilities into base class
content: Move repeated responsibilities/collaborators to base class
Subclasses extend base (': BaseClass') with only specific responsibilities
Example: Scanner (base) has shared responsibilities; ImportPlacementScanner : Scanner adds specific ones
Don't repeat same responsibilities in every subclass
Don't list every concrete subtype when base type exists
